functions.name: checkout(cart, customer)
functions.before:
// TypeScript
validateCart(cart)
total = calculateTotal(cart)
legacyReceipt = chargeCard(customer.card, total)
order = saveOrder(cart, customer, legacyReceipt)
return order
functions.after:
// TypeScript
validateCart(cart)
total = calculateTotal(cart)
payment = processPayment(customer, total, retry = false)
if payment.failed:
  payment = processPayment(customer, total, retry = true)
receipt = createReceipt(payment, cart, customer, includeTaxBreakdown = true)
order = saveOrder(cart, customer, receipt)
return order

functions.name: chargeCard(card, amount)
functions.before:
request = buildLegacyChargeRequest(card, amount)
response = legacyGateway.send(request)
if response.declined:
  throw PaymentDeclined(response.reason)
return response.receipt
